findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: guardian_check_iban · Private data: intrastat_compose, intrastat_reference, guardian_list_suppliers, guardian_supplier_ledger, guardian_supplier_status, guardian_check_iban, guardian_watch_supplier · Public sink: verify_payee, guardian_check_iban.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: guardian_check_iban · Private data: intrastat_compose, intrastat_reference, guardian_list_suppliers, guardian_supplier_ledger, guardian_supplier_status, guardian_check_iban, guardian_watch_supplier · Public sink: verify_payee, guardian_check_iban

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
